about_short_description.short_description: JustPaid provides AI-powered accounts receivable software.

product.name: JustPaid AI Revenue Operations Platform
product.description: A B2B finance platform that automates billing, invoicing, payment tracking, accounts receivable, collections, reconciliation, and revenue visibility across finance systems.

product.name: Billing Automation
product.description: Automates invoice creation, scheduling, delivery, and tracking for recurring, usage-based, milestone, hybrid, and other complex B2B pricing models.

product.name: Accounts Receivable and Collections Automation
product.description: Automates payment reminders, dunning sequences, escalation workflows, payment tracking, and invoice-to-payment follow-up to help finance teams manage receivables.

product.name: Contract & Billing AI
product.description: Uses AI to extract billing terms, payment schedules, obligations, renewals, and line items from contracts and convert them into billing and finance workflows.

product.name: Usage-Based Billing & Metering
product.description: Provides usage-event ingestion, real-time metering, aggregation, flexible pricing, and invoice generation for consumption-based and AI-oriented business models.

product.name: Payment Reconciliation and Revenue Insights
product.description: Matches payments from payment processors, bank accounts, and accounting systems to invoices and provides dashboards for collections, outstanding balances, and revenue trends.
